description: Thinly sliced protein 'cooked' in lime juice with lemongrass and herbs.
descriptionKm: ភ្លៀ — សាច់ស្រស់ មុជទឹកក្រូចឆ្មារ បៀបឆាសុីវី។

ingredients.notesKm: ចេញសំបក ហើយយកសរសៃ
ហាន់ស្ដើងបំផុត

ingredients.itemKm: ខ្ទឹមក្រហម
ជីអង្ការ និងស្លឹកសុណ្ដ
ទឹកក្រូចឆ្មារ
ម្ទេសខ្មាំង

instructions.text: Slice the shrimp very thinly and toss with half the lime juice; leave 10 minutes until it turns opaque.
instructions.tip: Use only the freshest seafood/meat for a lime-cured pleah.

instructions.text: Whisk the dressing — lime juice, fish sauce, palm sugar, garlic and chili — until the sugar dissolves.
Combine the shrimp with lemongrass, shallot, sawtooth coriander & mint.
Pour over the dressing and toss well just before serving.
Pile onto a plate and top with extra herbs, peanuts and fried shallots.
